value.answer: Call 911 now, or go straight to the ER - chest retractions mean this baby is working hard to breathe and needs emergency care right away.
value.triage: Do not wait or call 811 for this - it is an emergency now. Call 911 or get to the nearest ER immediately, especially if lips or face look blue/dusky, breathing looks fast, or the baby seems limp or hard to wake.
